reports.title: New regulations for Bussey Brake bass reinstated
reports.text:
Louisiana Department of Wildlife and Fisheries (LDWF) officials requested swift Commission action after discovering an error in the upcoming 2027 regulations.
In response, the Louisiana Wildlife and Fisheries Commission approved a declaration of emergency (DOE) and a Notice of Intent (NOI) at its Nov. 5 meeting to adjust bass fishing regulations at the Bussey Brake Wildlife Management Area (WMA).
Robby Maxwell, an Inland Fisheries biologist, explained to commissioners that the June 2026 hunting regulations inadvertently reverted the bass regulation back to a 16-inch maximum limit.
